title: Homework set: solving equations with graphs (with the printed curve)
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 1: Revision cycle 1: Number, algebra, sequences, graphs
source: Written for mathematics/y11 lesson 69 (Complete the portal's graphical solutions set (6 questions, with a printable curve) and update your repair list.)
intro: 6 questions. Use the curve y = x² − 2x − 3 below; draw lines on it with a ruler. Mark it with the mark scheme and add any errors to your repair list.

questions.q: Use the graph to solve x² − 2x − 3 = 0.
Use the graph to solve x² − 2x − 3 = 5.
questions.a: Read across at y = 5 (M1): x = −2 and x = 4 (A1)

questions.q: Draw the line y = x + 1 on the grid. Use it to solve x² − 2x − 3 = x + 1.
questions.a: Line drawn (B1); intersections (M1); x = −1 and x = 4 (A1)

questions.q: Which straight line should you draw on the grid to solve x² − 4x + 1 = 0?
Draw a tangent at x = 3 and use it to estimate the gradient of the curve there.
Write down the coordinates of the turning point of the curve.
